feeds.title: Kveller
feeds.description: Whether you grew up observing Shabbat every Friday night, or had your first taste of matzah ball soup when you married into a Jewish family, there's no one way to parent Jewish kids. Kveller is here to give you ideas you can run with - ideas for first-time parents, interfaith parents, queer parents, adoptive parents, and everything in between -with the hopes that you can find information and inspiration that is right for your family.

feeds.title: Creative Jewish Mom
feeds.description: A creative Jewish mom blogs about her busy creative life, featuring crafts for Jewish holidays and everyday, crafts for kids, Jewish cooking, gardening in Israel and much more.

feeds.title: Smashing the Glass
feeds.description: Hello, Im Karen Cinnamon, welcome to Smashing The Glass, the biggest Jewish wedding blog in the world, and the only Jewish wedding blog in UK.Find creative, inventive and original ideas for style-focused Jewish soon-to-be brides and grooms.

feeds.title: She Opens Her Bible
feeds.description: Helping you open the Bible—and your heart—to God's Word. Messianic Jewish and Christian voices together.

feeds.title: Between Carpools
feeds.description: A lifestyle site for busy Jewish women.

feeds.title: Finding Emunah
feeds.description: My name is Hana. I am a Bukharian Jew, born in Israel and raised in Colorado. I am a full-time single mom of 3 beautiful kids. I express myself through writing, music, and pictures. I love photography. My goal for this blog is to write what I have learned about specific topics such as Torah, Parshas, lectures, or even quotes that really inspire me. In this blog, I will also talk about how I started connecting spiritually to Hashem again.

feeds.title: Ima on and off the Bima
feeds.description: Real-Life Jewish parenting...from the laptop of a rabbi-mom of FOUR kids on the NorthShore of Chicago...join our journey!

feeds.title: Building Jewish Bridges Blog
feeds.description: Building Jewish Bridges joyously supports interfaith/intercultural families in exploring where they want Judaism to fit in their family and community life through online and in-person conversations, workshops, social events and couples counseling. Embracing Jews married to non-Jews and their families. Explore, learn, celebrate!

feeds.title: Jewish Mom
feeds.description: Providing inspiration and encouragement for other Jewish moms through inspirational articles. Jewish Mom blog is dedicated to providing a much-deserved pat-on-the-back and much-needed inspirational pick-me-up to Jewish moms. Chana Jenny Weisberg, the creator of this blog, is a stay-home mother of 8 children living in Jerusalem with her husband Rabbi Joshua Weisberg.

feeds.title: Out of the Ortho Box
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ruchi Koval. I'm an Orthodox Jewish woman. Married, kids. This blog is about promoting Jewish unity among people of all beliefs via mutual respect and education.

feeds.title: Raising them Jewish
feeds.description: A Jewish wife, an unclear husband- growing, living and learning. A toddler and hopefully more on the way. Raising Jewish Children as a working mom in south Orange County

feeds.title: A Mother in Israel
feeds.description: A Mother in Israel is a community of parents and parents-to-be from around the world. Social commentary on parenting, baby names, Israel, Judaism, modesty, breastfeeding, homemaking, economics, education and more.

feeds.title: Jewish Latin Princess Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Jewish Latin Princess, where Jewish femininity takes a Latin twist. I hope you find JLP a warm, friendly and inspiring place to visit. Yael is dedicated to building a Jewish home, which provides real-life content for her blog, podcast and new courses for women.
